title: Check-odds phrasing '(roll N+ on the die; +X skill)' states the raw d20 value needed, not the total against the DC — e.g. 'roll 7+; +2 wits' resolved as 'd20:6+2=8 vs DC 10 (10+ succeeds) — fail,' i.e. the die alone had to hit 8, not the total hit 7. Took several actual resolutions to confirm this reading; easy to misjudge your odds from the menu alone.
